about: Leeds and the Thousand Islands is a township in the United Counties of Leeds and Grenville, Ontario, along the St. Lawrence River—not a city, and not the separate Town of Gananoque. Hamlets such as Lansdowne, Seeley’s Bay, Lyndhurst, Rockport, and Ivy Lea sit among islands, parkway shoreline, and Rideau Canal country. About 10,000 people live in the township.
seoSummary: St. Lawrence township of Lansdowne, Rockport, and Seeley’s Bay—Thousand Islands countryside, not Gananoque.
